title: Stoipath Learn L2 practice report files (stoipath.learn.signout-case/1, stoipath.learn.worklist/1, stoipath.learn.signout-results/1)
description: The closed schemas of the practice report's files (SIGNOUT.md §4, §7.1, §7.2, Appendix A-D; owner: casefmt from Wave S1, skeleton by the sign-out integrator). Entry points: $defs/SignoutCaseModule (a whole case file: Learn's ModuleFile plus the case-level rules), $defs/SignoutCase (extensions.signout), $defs/WorklistFile, $defs/SignoutResultsFile, $defs/SlideIndex ($ref to slide-index.schema.json, owned by source) and $defs/FactsFile ($ref to Learn's). Subschemas carrying the annotation keyword x-lint-rule mirror a semantic lint rule of §7.2: validators that do not know the keyword ignore it (JSON Schema 2020-12 annotations); src/signout/casefmt evaluates them after the structural pass so that its parser reports one error per fault, and its lint reports them under the named rule. The TypeScript twin is stage0/client/src/signout/contracts.ts §1, §2, §5; the TypeScript reader is src/signout/casefmt/parse.ts, which interprets this file itself.

NodeLabel.description: CAMELYON17 node label, ordinal negative < itc < micro < macro (SIGNOUT.md §6.1).

PnCategory.description: pN under CAMELYON17's simplified rules, ordinal pN0 < pN0(i+) < pN1mi < pN1 < pN2 (§6.1).

NodeIndex.description: The data set's node index 0-4 (D29); learner-facing strings add one.

SlideRef.description: A ModuleSlide.ref of the case (module.schema.json SlideRef).

SlideId.description: The data set's slide id (patient_017_node_0): used after submission and in exports only (D12).

NeutralText.description: D12 / ER-15: a learner-visible identity that names no label, stage or patient id (lint so-labels-neutral).

largestDeposit_um.description: Maximum Feret diameter of the largest single polygon, µm (§6.3).

clusterSpan_um.description: Feret of the merged polygons within 100 µm: annotation geometry, never a deposit size.

borderline.description: PE-3: only on an itc or micro node with an annotation.

largestPolygon_um.description: Maximum Feret diameter of the cluster's largest single polygon, µm (S3 review fix, SIGNOUT.md §19.5): the deposit size the comparison prints; feret_um is the cluster span (annotation geometry, §6.3). Optional so that case files written before it still read (the comparison then falls back to feret_um).

layer.description: An overlay layer id of the slide's catalogue entry (camelyon17-annotation).

TissueCells.description: A coarse tissue mask of the node's slide (S3 review fix, SIGNOUT.md §19.5; copied from the slide index's pixels.tissueGrid by build_signout_cases.py). Cells of `cell` level-0 px, `cols` x `rows`, row-major; `bits` is hex, four cells per digit, most significant bit first, zero-padded. A sharp settled view counts as over tissue (examined, the tray's viewed-at, where-you-looked) only when it meets a tissue cell.

allOf.description: A size appears only on a node with an annotation (lint so-size-annotated).
borderline only on an itc or micro node that has an annotation (lint so-borderline).

NodeIsPositive.description: A case node whose reference label is micro or macro (used by the so-pn-derivable mirror).

NodeIsMacro.description: A case node whose reference label is macro (used by the so-pn-derivable mirror).

NodeIsMicro.description: A case node whose reference label is micro (used by the so-pn-derivable mirror).

NodeIsItc.description: A case node whose reference label is itc (used by the so-pn-derivable mirror).

SignoutCase.description: extensions.signout of a case module (SIGNOUT.md §7.1, Appendix A; contracts.ts §1 SignoutCase). Closed. The allOf members tagged x-lint-rule mirror the semantic lint rules of §7.2 (the TypeScript parser evaluates them after the structure, the lint reports them under their own rule id).

patient.description: Shown only after submission and in exports (D12).

allOf.description: reference.pN follows from the node labels under CAMELYON17's simplified rules (§6.1), and the four counts equal the counts of the labels (lint so-pn-derivable).

SignoutCaseModule.description: A whole case file: a Learn module (module.schema.json, Learn's format parses it) with the case-level constraints of SIGNOUT.md §7.1 / §7.2 and extensions.signout. Python validates against this entry point; the TypeScript parser leaves the module part to Learn's format.parseModule.

allOf.description: D13 / PE-6: the vignette is invented, generic and labelled (lint so-vignette-invented).

allOf.pattern: labels each slide as one node

allOf.description: A sign-out case has no items and one Open tour step (lint so-items-empty).

WorklistFile.description: A practice worklist (SIGNOUT.md §7.1, Appendix D; contracts.ts §2 WorklistFile). Closed.

practiceStatement.const: Practice report on public de-identified teaching cases. Not a diagnostic or sign-out tool.

url.description: Relative to the worklist file (same origin).

largestDeposit_um.description: Contract 3 (A-RES-Q1): this node's reference largest single annotated deposit in µm, null without one. Optional: results files written before contract 3 omit it.

CaseResult.description: SIGNOUT.md §6.5 (contracts.ts §4 CaseResult) plus the results file's case block and trace kind (Appendix C ResultsCase). No composite score (Q5).

SignoutResultsFile.description: stoipath.learn.signout-results/1 (SIGNOUT.md Appendix C, D22, PE-8, PE-13, PE-19, PE-21; contracts.ts §5). Closed: no name, email, user id, device id or time zone.

labelString.const: For educational use. Not a medical device. Contains no protected health information.

practiceStatement.const: Practice report on public de-identified teaching cases. Not a diagnostic or sign-out tool.

useStatement.const: Formative practice data on draft teaching cases. Not validated for high-stakes decisions about a trainee; use it for feedback, curriculum and programme evaluation only.

privacy.const: Created in your browser. Nothing in this file was sent anywhere; it contains only what you typed and did.

SlideIndex.description: A per-slide index (SIGNOUT.md §8.1, Appendix B), by reference to its own schema (owner: source; ER-13a: one writer, never copied here).

FactsFile.description: A case's facts file (LEARN.md CNT-4's mechanism; SIGNOUT.md §15.3), by reference to Learn's definition.
